output.meta_commit_message:
fix(test-selection): rank coverage-contexts baselines by breadth, not mtime

resolve_baseline sorted cached baselines by file mtime and took the first
ancestor of HEAD, so the most recently written database won regardless of how
much attribution it actually held. That was fine while every baseline arrived
as a CI artifact, and stopped being fine once tools/install_coverage_contexts
added a second, local supply route: a thin 7 MB local record could displace a
49 MB CI record holding 13x the attribution pairs.

Measure each cached database's breadth (contexts, attribution pairs, files)
directly over SQLite through a read-only URI, which takes ~17ms on a 49 MB
database instead of seconds through CoverageData. Memoize the result in a
<sha>.sqlite.breadth.json sidecar keyed on the database's size and mtime_ns so
a re-recorded SHA is measured again rather than read through stale numbers;
prune_baselines removes the sidecar alongside its database, and
fetch_coverage_contexts writes it at fetch time.

resolve_baseline now ranks ancestors of HEAD by commit distance and takes the
nearest one holding at least 75% of the best candidate's attribution pairs.
Unreadable databases count as zero and never displace a readable one, and the
ordering degrades to plain distance when nothing is measurable.

install_coverage_contexts gains a third guard refusing a database whose
attribution density is under half that of the densest already cached, with
--allow-thin to override; it never fires when no measurable reference exists.

[1]: https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-g9/README.md

    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    result = d.get("result", "") or ""
    message = d.get("message", "") or ""
    changespec_name = d.get("changespec_name", "") or ""
    name = d.get("name", "") or ""

    if result:
        out["meta_new_commit"] = result
    if message:
        out["meta_commit_message"] = message
    cs = changespec_name or name
    if cs:
        out["meta_changespec"] = cs
    if diff_path:

import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch.  Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# ChangeSpec name -> branch name conversion.
is_changespec = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_changespec:
        # ChangeSpec ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)
